patch_resolves_note: The real fix commit adds `if (oldDigit == INVALID_DIGIT) { return H3_NULL; }` in `h3NeighborRotations()`. On the original witness the fixed build reaches the guarded root-cause iteration with `oldDigit == INVALID_DIGIT` and does not execute the protected lookup, while the closest boundary perturbation `-EEE0E0EE0E4E` executes that same lookup with a valid row digit and remains clean.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-code statement that consumes the staged witness string and materializes the raw 64-bit `H3Index` value whose digit fields later drive the invalid table lookup.
The digit-adjustment loop chooses between translation tables using only `isResolutionClassIII(r + 1)` and never rejects `oldDigit == INVALID_DIGIT` before using `oldDigit` as the row index.

UBSan crash site. The class-III branch reads the constant direction table with `oldDigit == 7` and `dir == IJ_AXES_DIGIT (6)`, so the expression evaluates `NEW_DIGIT_II[7][6]` and indexes row 7 of a `Direction[7][7]` object.

edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace shows `root_cause_digit_guard.old_digit == root_cause_digit_lookup_sink.row_digit == 7`.
